objective: Add --scope user|project|local and --undo to `holyagent setup` (and --scope to `holyagent doctor`), keeping today's opinionated defaults and default scope user.
scope: packages/runtime/src/cli/setup.ts and packages/runtime/src/setup/* (settings merge, report, doctor)
packages/integrations/claude/src/setup-command.md (argument-hint and notes for the new flags)
the generated plugin under packages/integrations/claude/dist, rebuilt with `mise run build`
constraints: Scope picks the settings file the same way Claude Code names its scopes: user = CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json else ~/.claude/settings.json (today's behavior, still the default); project = <git top-level of the cwd, else cwd>/.claude/settings.json; local = the same folder's .claude/settings.local.json. Reason: someone trying HolyAgent can confine it to one repository instead of every project.
--scope project and local merge the same keys with the same never-overwrite rule. extraKnownMarketplaces and enabledPlugins stay in the chosen file too.

--undo removes from the chosen scope's file only values equal to what setup writes: a key whose value differs is left alone and reported with `~`; from permissions.deny it removes only the WebSearch and WebFetch entries and drops the list/permissions object only if it becomes empty; from modelSettings["claude-opus-5-5"] only effortLevel high and autoCompactWindow 450000, dropping empty parent objects. It does not uninstall ctx7. It honors --dry-run. Report lines use `-` for removed (or a clearly documented marker consistent with the existing report legend) and `=` for nothing to remove. Reason: a user must be able to back out exactly what setup changed.

Use Effect and Effect Schema per .claude/CLAUDE.md (no try/catch, no async functions, tagged errors, decode with onExcessProperty error); JSDoc on every exported item; validate --scope values with a clear error.
Update the setup usage/help text in setup.ts. Do not edit docs/ or README.md (another writer owns them) and do not touch .github/.
No version-control writes, no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When done and checked, stop and report; name unrequested features instead of adding them. Do not stop on a summary that announces a next step.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file outside the repository and give its path.

notes:
- **Undo and the cache lifetime:** `--undo` compares `subagentPromptCacheTtl` with `--subagent-cache-ttl` (default 1h). Someone who set up with 5m must pass `--subagent-cache-ttl 5m` to undo it. Otherwise it is kept and reported with `~`.
- **Undo report lines:** removed keys print `- <key>: removed …`. In undo mode `-` therefore means removed, and `=` means nothing to remove. I documented this in the CLI help and `setup-command.md`. A dry run keeps the `removed` wording and the summary says `would remove N`.
- **ctx7 line:** `--undo` prints one `~ ctx7: left installed…` line.
- **ctx7 install:** ctx7 and its skill still install at user level whatever the scope.
- **SessionStart notice:** it still checks the user settings only. Someone who ran setup with `--scope project` will keep seeing "setup is incomplete" in other projects. I left it alone as unrequested.
- **Git detection:** project and local scope use `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` through the existing `Shell` service. If git is missing or the directory is not a repository, the current directory is used.
- **Doctor hint:** the doctor fix hint names `--scope` when the scope is not user.
